John Bicourt was 4th in the Junior 2 miles at the AAA Indoor Championships at Wembley over Easter. His 9:35.8 was 22.6 secs. behind the winner, Young of Hornchurch.
Ray Hall held his own throughout and finished strongly to beat both his race rivals, Green and Young. Barnes and Cameron retired in the closing stages.

The leading group were quickly away with Young and Lightman making much of the early pace, Eley and Thompson sitting in. Further back Pat Duncan seemed happy to let things go for a while, Dave King and Bob were well up with George Beecham and John settling in to build the team foundations.
